key_insight: Crystoria links thermodynamic and phonon-based dynamical stability at million-structure scale to support materials AI.
engineering_relevance: The dataset can help materials AI workflows prioritize dynamically stable crystal candidates beyond energy-based screening alone.
method: Curate low-energy and metastable inorganic crystals and standardize structural identities.
Screen dynamical stability using phonon calculations.
evidence_signal: Crystoria contains 2,649,640 structures spanning 89 elements, 219 space groups, and 1–48 atoms per primitive cell; 1,793,353 structures (67.68%) are classified as dynamically stable.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify validation against higher-fidelity calculations or experiments, so predictive reliability needs assessment before engineering deployment.
paper_title: Crystoria: A Large-Scale Crystal Dataset Linking Thermodynamic and Dynamical Stability for Materials AI
